# Monorepo restructure: move the engine to packages/graph-execution

## What to build

Turn this repository into an npm-workspaces monorepo. Move the whole graph-execution engine (the published npm package `graph-execution`) from the repo root into `packages/graph-execution/`. Make the root a private workspace package with workspaces `["packages/*", "apps/*"]`. Create `apps/` with a `.gitkeep`; a later task adds `apps/graph-manager`. The engine must keep working exactly as before:
- same tests and same CLI
- same npm tarball contents (`dist`, `skills`, `README.md`, `LICENSE`, `package.json`)
- CI keeps running `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` at the root

This task only moves files and fixes paths. No behaviour changes. Use `git mv` so history follows the files.

## Target layout

```
package.json                    NEW private root (workspaces, delegating scripts, shared devDependencies)
package-lock.json               regenerated with `npm install` at the root
eslint.config.js                stays at the root, globs updated
graph-execution.config.json     stays at the root (graph-execution reads it from the git root); it already runs `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`; do not change it
README.md                       NEW short monorepo README (see below)
CLAUDE.md, TESTING.md           stay at the root, paths updated
CHANGELOG.md                    git mv into packages/graph-execution/
LICENSE                         git mv into packages/graph-execution/ AND keep a copy at the root (cp after the mv)
.github/workflows/qa.yml        stays; still runs npm ci / typecheck / lint / test at the root
.claude/, .agents/, docs/prd, docs/wiki, ralph-loop.sh, ralph-logs/   stay at the root
apps/.gitkeep                   NEW
packages/graph-execution/
  package.json                  the current root package.json, adjusted (see below)
  README.md                     the current README.md (git mv), image links unchanged (docs/img/...)
  docs/img/                     git mv docs/img here (README images are relative to the README)
  src/ scripts/ skills/ demo/   git mv
  tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json vitest.config.ts vitest.global-setup.ts   git mv
```

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `package.json`: the whole file becomes `packages/graph-execution/package.json`. The postbuild script copies `src/web/page.html`, `src/suite/page.html` and `src/web/assets` and runs `node scripts/render-readme.mjs README.md dist/README.html`. These paths are relative to the package dir and keep working if the build runs there.
- `src/e2e.test.ts` (lines 12-29): packs the package and symlinks `path.join(root, "node_modules")` into the extracted tarball. With workspaces, dependencies are hoisted to `<repo>/node_modules`, so `packages/graph-execution/node_modules` usually doesn't exist and the packed bin can't find commander, ink and the rest. Lines 70-76 assert the tarball files are exactly `dist`, `skills`, `README.md`, `LICENSE`, `package.json`.
- `src/ci-workflow.test.ts` (lines 6-7, 11, 26): `root` is the folder above `src/` and `workflowsDir = path.join(root, ".github", "workflows")`. After the move, `root` is `packages/graph-execution` and the workflows are two levels higher. Line 26 resolves `scripts/...` references in workflow files against `root`.
- `scripts/render-readme.mjs` (lines 6, 78-80): copies `path.dirname(source)/docs/img` next to the rendered page. Works unchanged once `docs/img` sits next to the package README.
- `eslint.config.js`: ignores `dist/`, `src/web/assets/vendor/`. Its `files` globs are `src/web/assets/**/*.js` and `skills/**/*.mjs`, `.claude/skills/**/*.mjs`, `scripts/**/*.mjs`.
- `.github/workflows/qa.yml`: runs `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` at the root on ubuntu and macos with Node 22.
- `CLAUDE.md` (lines 18-26, 36) and `TESTING.md` (lines 9-11, 34, 100): use `npm run build`, `node dist/cli.js`, `$PWD/dist/cli.js`, `$PWD/src/__fixtures__`, `src/providers/fake.ts`, `demo/suite/run.sh`.
- `demo/suite/run.sh` (lines 13-14, 27): `ROOT="$(cd "$HERE/../.." && pwd)"`, then `npm run build` and `node "$ROOT/dist/cli.js"`. Moved together with the package, `$HERE/../..` is the package root and the script keeps working.
- `src/review/context.ts` (lines 8, 65-66): reads TESTING.md and REVIEW.md from the *git root* of the repo being worked on. TESTING.md must stay at the repo root.
- `src/config/config.ts` (lines 51-52): loads `graph-execution.config.json` from the git root. It stays at the root.

Everything else inside `src/` finds files relative to its own module (`new URL("..", import.meta.url)`, `../../skills/`, `../package.json`). It keeps working when `src/`, `skills/`, `README.md` and `package.json` move together.

## Step-by-step tasks

### MOVE files with git mv

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  ```bash
  mkdir -p packages/graph-execution/docs apps && touch apps/.gitkeep
  git mv src scripts skills demo tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json vitest.config.ts vitest.global-setup.ts README.md CHANGELOG.md package.json packages/graph-execution/
  git mv docs/img packages/graph-execution/docs/img
  git mv LICENSE packages/graph-execution/LICENSE && cp packages/graph-execution/LICENSE LICENSE
  ```
- **GOTCHA**: `ralph-loop.sh` and `ralph-logs/` stay at the root.

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/package.json`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - Keep name, version, bin, files, dependencies, all scripts and `prepublishOnly` as they are.
  - Add `"directory": "packages/graph-execution"` to `repository`, so npm resolves README links and images against the right folder.
  - Move the devDependencies shared with other workspaces to the root: `@eslint/js`, `eslint`, `typescript-eslint`, `typescript`, `vitest`, `@types/node`. Keep `@types/react`, `ink-testing-library` and `marked` in the engine.
  - Keep `"typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"`, `"test": "vitest run"` and `"build"`.
  - Remove the engine's `lint` script (lint runs once at the root). `prepublishOnly` becomes `npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build`, plus `npx eslint .` run from the package dir. That works because the root config is found by walking up; flat config is looked up from the cwd upward.

### CREATE root `package.json`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  ```json
  {
    "name": "graph-execution-monorepo",
    "private": true,
    "type": "module",
    "workspaces": ["packages/*", "apps/*"],
    "engines": { "node": ">=20" },
    "scripts": {
      "build": "npm run build --workspaces --if-present",
      "typecheck": "npm run build -w graph-execution && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present",
      "lint": "eslint .",
      "test": "npm test --workspaces --if-present"
    },
    "devDependencies": { "@eslint/js": "…", "@types/node": "…", "eslint": "…", "typescript": "…", "typescript-eslint": "…", "vitest": "…" }
  }
  ```
  - Use the exact version ranges from the current package.json.
  - `typecheck` builds the engine first, on purpose: later workspaces import its emitted `dist` types.
- Then run `rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install` at the root to regenerate the lockfile. It must contain `packages/graph-execution` as a workspace entry.
- **GOTCHA**: `npm ci` must pass afterwards. Commit the new `package-lock.json`.

### UPDATE `eslint.config.js` (root)

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - ignores: `"**/dist/", "**/node_modules/", ".graph-execution/", "ralph-logs/", ".agents/", "packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/vendor/"`
  - browser files: `"packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/**/*.js"`
  - node scripts: `"packages/*/skills/**/*.mjs", "packages/*/scripts/**/*.mjs", ".claude/skills/**/*.mjs", "apps/*/scripts/**/*.mjs"`
- **VALIDATE**: `npx eslint .` at the root reports nothing.

### FIX `packages/graph-execution/src/e2e.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: Find the nearest existing `node_modules` by walking up from `root`:
  ```ts
  let modules = path.join(root, "node_modules");
  for (let dir = root; !existsSync(modules); ) {
    const up = path.dirname(dir);
    if (up === dir) break;
    dir = up;
    modules = path.join(dir, "node_modules");
  }
  ```
  Symlink that one into the extracted package.
- Keep the files assertion as it is: `LICENSE` and `README.md` now live in the package dir.

### FIX `packages/graph-execution/src/ci-workflow.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `const pkgRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");`
  - `const repoRoot = path.resolve(pkgRoot, "..", "..");`
  - `workflowsDir = path.join(repoRoot, ".github", "workflows")`
  - Resolve script refs against `repoRoot`, falling back to `pkgRoot`: a ref is missing only when neither has it.

### UPDATE docs

- **Root `README.md`, new and short:**
  - What the repo is, with a table of workspaces:
    - `packages/graph-execution`: the open-source CLI, link to its README
    - `apps/graph-manager`: the web service around it (coming)
  - How to develop: `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build -w graph-execution`.
  - The engine's user docs live in `packages/graph-execution/README.md`.
- **`CLAUDE.md`:**
  - `npm run build` becomes `npm run build -w graph-execution`.
  - `node dist/cli.js` becomes `node packages/graph-execution/dist/cli.js`, still run from the repo root.
  - Checks become `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test`.
  - The known failing test path becomes `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.test.ts`.
- **`TESTING.md`:**
  - `npm run build -w graph-execution`
  - `CLI="$PWD/packages/graph-execution/dist/cli.js"`
  - `FIX="$PWD/packages/graph-execution/src/__fixtures__"`
  - `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/fake.ts`
  - `packages/graph-execution/demo/suite/run.sh`
- **`docs/wiki/*.md` and `docs/wiki/features/*.md`:** add `packages/graph-execution/` in front of code references (`src/...`, `scripts/...`, `skills/...`) where it's cheap. A sed over the backticked `` `src/ `` is fine.
- **`.claude/skills/*`:** leave as is.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `git status` shows renames (`R`), not delete+add, for the moved engine files.
- [ ] Root: `npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` passes. One known environment failure is allowed: in `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.test.ts`, "exits 2 at startup when --provider claude is not on the PATH" fails where a real `claude` is installed.
- [ ] `npm run build -w graph-execution` creates `packages/graph-execution/dist/cli.js`; `node packages/graph-execution/dist/cli.js --version` prints `1.2.0`.
- [ ] `cd packages/graph-execution && npm pack --dry-run` lists only `dist/`, `skills/`, `README.md`, `LICENSE`, `package.json`.
- [ ] `node packages/graph-execution/dist/cli.js readme` still renders a README with images: `packages/graph-execution/dist/docs/img/*.png` exist after the build.
- [ ] `graph-execution.config.json` is unchanged and its commands (`npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`) work at the root.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm ci
npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
npm run build -w graph-execution && node packages/graph-execution/dist/cli.js --version
(cd packages/graph-execution && npm pack --dry-run 2>&1 | tail -20)
```
